## File: google-deepmind_actionengine/third_party/pybind11/docs/benchmark.py

Prompts

```
['generate C++ source code with pybind11 bindings for a given number of random classes', 'generate C++ source code with Boost.Python bindings for a given number of random classes', 'run the compilation benchmark comparing pybind11 and Boost.Python build times and output sizes', 'review the pybind11 dummy code generator function to understand its class and binding generation logic', 'refactor the Boost.Python dummy code generator to support configurable functions per class or arguments per function']
```

Usage

```
{'generate_dummy_code_pybind11': 'generate C++ source code with pybind11 bindings for a given number of random classes', 'generate_dummy_code_boost': 'generate C++ source code with Boost.Python bindings for a given number of random classes', 'run_benchmark': 'run the compilation benchmark comparing pybind11 and Boost.Python build times and output sizes', 'review_generate_dummy_code_pybind11': 'review the pybind11 dummy code generator function to understand its class and binding generation logic', 'refactor_generate_dummy_code_boost': 'refactor the Boost.Python dummy code generator to support configurable functions per class or arguments per function'}
```
